001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.scopedkeyvalues.spi;
002
003/**
004 * Service Provider Interface {@link java.util.ServiceLoader} actually discovers for
005 * {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.scopedkeyvalues.ScopedKeyValues} - a factory rather than
006 * the {@link ScopedKeyValuesProvider} itself, since a factory method can do things a bare
007 * no-arg-constructor {@link java.util.ServiceLoader} instantiation cannot (validate
008 * preconditions, choose between alternate implementations, read configuration, etc)
009 * without {@code ScopedKeyValues} needing to know anything about how the provider it gets
010 * back was actually put together.
011 */
012public interface ScopedKeyValuesProviderFactory {
013
014        /**
015         * Creates (or otherwise obtains) the provider.
016         * @return provider, never {@code null}.
017         */
018        ScopedKeyValuesProvider provide();
019
020}
